answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be replenished through sustained, honest service rather than one-time endorsements. EigenTrust factorization, tempered by reciprocity-weighted transitivity, assigns freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; even a velvet, willow, or ferrous alias therefore lacks trusted mass and cannot satisfy consensus thresholds.
